encode_messages: encode a list of chat messages into a DS32-formatted prompt string with optional thinking mode
parse_message_from_completion_text: parse a model completion text into structured assistant message with reasoning and tool calls
render_message: render a single chat message at a given index into DS32 prompt format for system, user, assistant, developer, or tool roles
render_tools: render a list of tool schemas into the DS32 system template with DSML tokens and thinking tokens
drop_thinking_messages: remove reasoning_content from assistant messages and filter out thinking-only messages from the conversation
